Description.Name: Jannet Frost
Description.Details: Jannet Frost was born into a family of pirates. Her own ideals, however, drew her away from the pirate life. She now serves as a highly skilled mercenary MechWarrior. Her callsign, "Helix", is a reference to her pilot lineage, to remind her that despite her family's choices, she is free to live by her own moral code.
